title: First declension paradigm (puella)
standardSummary: Decline puella in all cases singular and plural, and produce at least one more 1st-declension form correctly.
teach:
## First declension

Most first-declension nouns are feminine and end in **-a** in the nominative singular (dictionary form). Example: **puella, puellae** f. — girl.

### Endings (learn these cold)

| Case | Singular | Plural |
|------|----------|--------|
| Nominative | -a | -ae |
| Genitive | -ae | -ārum |
| Dative | -ae | -īs |
| Accusative | -am | -ās |
| Ablative | -ā | -īs |

Stem of *puella* is **puell-**. Attach the endings to the stem.

### Case jobs (preview)

- **Nominative** — subject (*Puella ambulat.* The girl walks.)
- **Genitive** — "of" (*aqua puellae* — the girl's water)
- **Dative** — to/for (*puellae* — to/for the girl)
- **Accusative** — direct object
- **Ablative** — by/with/from; also after *in* for place where (*in villā*)

You will practice cases with meaning soon. Today: **forms automaticity**.
